content.data: I build and evolve Shopify storefronts end‑to‑end — from custom Liquid themes to Hydrogen v2 (Remix) with Storefront API. My focus is maintainability, performance, and accessibility.

data: Custom theme development (Liquid, OS 2.0) and deep theme customization.
Checkout and delivery logic on Shopify Plus using Functions and metafields.
App development when the theme layer isn’t enough (proxy apps, serverless endpoints).
Headless storefronts with Hydrogen v2, aligned with design systems.

content.data: Modern React/TypeScript workflows with a strong emphasis on typed APIs, DX, and measurable outcomes (A11y, SEO, analytics quality).

data: TypeScript + React component systems for scalable UIs.
Next.js and Remix for content‑rich and headless experiences.
GA4 migration and e‑commerce event models; validation with DebugView/Tag Assistant.
WCAG‑oriented development and structured data for SEO.

content.data: Pragmatic performance passes focused on LCP, CLS and responsiveness, without breaking UX or delivery cadence.

data: Responsive images, WebP/AVIF where applicable, prioritized loading.
Inline critical CSS and defer/async of non‑critical assets.
Stabilize layout (CLS) in carousels, navigation, and PDP.
Continuous monitoring with Lighthouse and Chrome UX Report.
